coordinates.eventIntervals: Inclusive zero-based decoded clip frames; fps is clip playback FPS, not an independently certified physical clock.
coordinates.releaseTrackPoint: Background-stabilized original full-image pixels in the initial clip frame when cameraStabilized=true; otherwise original full-image pixels.
coordinates.releaseDetectionBox: XYXY pixels in the original crop video; distinct from stabilized track-point coordinates.

policy: Source-reviewed provisional events and automatic image-supported previews are separate. No wrist-speed substitution. Automatic previews never enter player headline statistics.
